$comment: Stub harness catalog. Plumbed in via SEMTEAMS_HARNESS_CATALOG_PATH so journeys can swap from the empty default to a non-empty catalog without rebuilding the image. The 'stub' entry is intentionally minimal — its only role is to verify the boot-time render path produces a non-empty researcher fragment. Real catalog entries ship in R3.7.2 (meshtasticd-3.x) and beyond.

harnesses.name: stub
harnesses.domain_description: Stub harness for e2e wiring verification. Not a real test harness; do not reference outside the research-harness-hit journey.
